title: OpenAICLIOptions
description: Native Codex exec CLI arguments used by Captain's OpenAI CLI runtime.

sources.reference: codex exec --help and codex exec resume --help

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: Prompt text written to Codex standard input.

model.title: Model
model.description: Codex model identifier used for the execution.

config.title: Configuration overrides
config.description: Codex TOML key-value overrides emitted on the command line.

image.title: Images
image.description: Local image paths attached to the initial prompt.

cd.title: Working directory
cd.description: Directory used as the Codex workspace root.

addDir.title: Additional directories
addDir.description: Additional directories granted write access alongside the primary workspace.

ephemeral.title: Ephemeral
ephemeral.description: Whether Codex avoids persisting session files.

ignoreUserConfig.title: Ignore user configuration
ignoreUserConfig.description: Whether Codex skips user-level configuration and instructions.

ignoreRules.title: Ignore rules
ignoreRules.description: Whether Codex skips repository instructions and hooks.

outputSchema.title: Output schema
outputSchema.description: Path to a JSON Schema constraining the final response.

resume.title: Resume session
resume.description: Codex thread identifier passed to the exec resume subcommand.

x-captain-option.note: Captain always selects Codex's non-interactive exec command.

json.title: JSON events
json.description: Whether Codex prints newline-delimited JSON events.

x-captain-option.note: Captain requires JSON events for typed stream parsing.

enable.title: Enable features
enable.description: Codex feature flags enabled for this invocation.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not expose raw Codex feature flags.

disable.title: Disable features
disable.description: Codex feature flags disabled for this invocation.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not expose raw Codex feature flags.

strictConfig.title: Strict configuration
strictConfig.description: Whether unknown configuration keys cause an error.

x-captain-option.note: Captain emits known configuration keys but does not enable strict parsing.

oss.title: Open-source provider
oss.description: Whether Codex uses a local open-source model provider.

x-captain-option.note: Captain's OpenAI CLI runtime uses the configured Codex provider.

localProvider.title: Local provider
localProvider.description: Local model provider selected when --oss is active.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not expose Codex local-provider selection.

profile.title: Configuration profile
profile.description: Named Codex configuration profile loaded for the invocation.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not select a Codex configuration profile.

approveForMe.title: Automatic approvals
approveForMe.description: Whether Codex chooses when to request command approval.

x-captain-option.note: Captain maps its permission mode through Codex approval_policy configuration.

dangerouslyBypassApprovalsAndSandbox.title: Bypass approvals and sandbox
dangerouslyBypassApprovalsAndSandbox.description: Whether Codex executes without approval prompts or sandbox isolation.

x-captain-option.note: Captain maps validated sandbox and approval settings separately.

dangerouslyBypassHookTrust.title: Bypass hook trust
dangerouslyBypassHookTrust.description: Whether Codex runs project hooks without trust confirmation.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not bypass Codex hook trust checks.

worktree.title: Worktree
worktree.description: Whether Codex creates and uses a temporary Git worktree.

x-captain-option.note: Captain executes in the explicitly supplied working directory.

threadSource.title: Thread source
threadSource.description: Source label attached to the created Codex thread.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not set a native Codex thread-source label.

skipGitRepoCheck.title: Skip Git repository check
skipGitRepoCheck.description: Whether Codex runs when the working directory is outside a Git repository.

x-captain-option.note: Captain leaves Codex's repository safety check enabled.

color.title: Color
color.description: Color policy used for human-readable Codex output.

x-captain-option.note: Captain consumes JSON event output rather than colored terminal text.

outputLastMessage.title: Last message output
outputLastMessage.description: File path receiving the final assistant message.

x-captain-option.note: Captain receives the final message through the JSON event stream.

resumeLast.title: Resume last session
resumeLast.description: Whether exec resume selects the most recent Codex thread.

x-captain-option.note: Captain resumes only an explicit session identifier.

resumeAll.title: List all resumable sessions
resumeAll.description: Whether exec resume ignores cwd filtering while selecting a thread.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not open the interactive resume picker.

help.title: Help
help.description: Whether Codex prints exec command help and exits.

x-captain-option.note: Captain executes requests rather than CLI help.

version.title: Version
version.description: Whether Codex prints its version and exits.

x-captain-option.note: Captain resolves the installed CLI version outside request execution.
